disputes.title: WAiNK total: 108 or 112?
disputes.a: The Games Wiki and GTA Spotter count 108 scans: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, 4 Peewees billboards and 15 No Flusher tags.
disputes.b: GameTrek counts 112, with 23 No Flusher tags instead of 15. Either way the trophy needs 100 scans, so the dispute changes nothing you must do.

disputes.title: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and KeenGamer say to do the balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1: it is the only interaction currently flagged as possibly missable.
disputes.b: GTADB notes whether the trophy actually needs that one meditation is still unresolved. Do it anyway — it costs a minute and the 100% list only needs 15 of 18.

disputes.title: How many Shooting Range challenges?
disputes.a: PowerPyx lists 12 challenges with 42 gold medals in one place and 14 in another; Push Square counts 42 challenges.
disputes.b: Every guide agrees on the number that matters: 42 gold medals across the two ranges, Griffin and Rodgers Ranch.

disputes.title: Final mission: Chapter 5, or just the final mission?
disputes.a: Beebom and CULTR word the final trophy as completing Chapter 5.
disputes.b: Most guides, including PowerPyx and KeenGamer, say only to complete the final story mission. Play the story to its end and it pops either way.
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

disputes.title: Two hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger
disputes.a: EGamers and KeenGamer list the conditions for In The Beginning… and Capital Offense as unconfirmed: only their joke descriptions are known.
disputes.b: Do not chase rumoured triggers. Both are flagged unconfirmed here until two guides agree on how they unlock.

disputes.title: Two more hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger
disputes.a: KeenGamer marks Ten Pin as 'precise method still being confirmed' and Personal Best has no confirmed trigger in any guide yet.
disputes.b: Their descriptions hint at a melee drive-by and a high-profile partnership, but hints are not unlocks. Both stay unconfirmed here.

stages.title: Story — Chapters 1–2
stages.blurb: Play the opening chapters and the first story missions. Save at the start of each chapter: there is no mission replay.

stages.title: Story — Chapters 3–5
stages.blurb: Finish the story. Chapter trophies and mission trophies pop as you go; the final mission unlocks the gold.

stages.title: Strangers & side missions
stages.blurb: Run the stranger mission strands to their final missions — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — plus Bret's hunt.

stages.title: Activities & pastimes
stages.blurb: Try every activity type once, then gold the shooting ranges, win the drone races and the races.

stages.title: Collectibles & counts
stages.blurb: The long grind: stunts, cards, WAiNK scans, vehicles, meditations, money and garages.

stages.title: Robberies, heat & the unknown
stages.blurb: Robberies and wanted-level stunts, the 100% checklist, and the hidden trophies nobody has solved yet.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Plan for roughly 200 hours in total, with A Long Road (100% completion) as the last trophy for most players.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops; no separate task is attached to it.
PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours. The hardest single trophy is A Long Road, so the platinum is really a 100% completion run.
Rockstar's official list is the source of the 55 names and grades used here; Exophase and PSNProfiles list the same 55, agreeing on every name, description and grade.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the opening mission Gone Fishing. It pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed — just play the story.

steps.text: Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing. The trophy pops at the mission's end.
There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter in case you want to revisit a mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before you leave the chapter — it is the one interaction flagged as possibly missable for another trophy.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 1. The trophy pops when the chapter ends.
Before leaving Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house: PowerPyx and KeenGamer flag it as the only currently identified possibly missable interaction.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. The asterisks are in the name as PlayStation publishes it. Chapter 2 unlocks the systems the rest of the guide relies on, including the shooting range and races.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2. The trophy pops when the chapter ends.
From Chapter 2 on, the shooting range, races and drone races are open, so the activity trophies can be started during the story rather than left to cleanup.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3 and arriving in Vice City proper — the neon heart of Leonida, one of the six regions Rockstar names for the state.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3. The trophy pops when the chapter ends.
Rockstar's six official regions are Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Keep scanning new vehicles with WAiNK and studying animals through the binoculars as you travel — both count toward 100% long before the checklist is visible.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 4. The trophy pops when the chapter ends.
Scan every new vehicle with WAiNK and study animals through the binoculars while you play: 100% needs 200 of 277 base vehicles and 100 of 255 animals.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold for finishing the story. Sources differ on the wording — some call it Chapter 5, most say only 'the final mission' — but the unlock is the same: play the story to its end.

steps.text: Complete the final story mission. The trophy pops at the end of the story.
On wording: Beebom and CULTR describe it as Chapter 5, while PowerPyx and KeenGamer say only the final mission. Either way, finishing the story earns it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run. It pops on completion; the mission's name is the only spoiler here.

steps.text: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. The trophy pops when it ends.
Mission trophies unlock in story order, so this one comes early — check the roadmap if you want to know which chapter it sits in before you play it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the heist mission The Cartel Heist. Heists also feed the 100% checklist, which wants every bank job, gang operation and vault — so the heist missions you play for the story are progress, not a detour.

steps.text: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. The trophy pops when it ends.
The 100% checklist needs all 22 bank jobs, 39 gang operations and 8 vaults, so every heist mission counts twice: story and checklist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play. It pops on completion.

steps.text: Complete the mission Child's Play. The trophy pops when it ends.
Story mission trophies cannot be missed: every story mission stays available until you finish it, since there is no mission replay to fall back on.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners. It pops on completion.

steps.text: Complete the mission Headliners. The trophy pops when it ends.
If a story mission feels hard, remember the checklist does not grade missions: there are no mission gold medals, only the shooting range and race challenge medals.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. VCIA is also the scene of a hidden trophy about an unscheduled departure — keep the airport in mind after the story.

steps.text: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The trophy pops when it ends.
The airport matters twice: this mission trophy, and the hidden Catch Me If You Can, which asks for an unscheduled departure from VCIA.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops on completion, late in the story.

steps.text: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The trophy pops when it ends.
After the story ends you return to free roam and the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold for the 100% Completion checklist — the hardest trophy in the game and the last one for most players. The checklist has 35 requirements and only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is far more lenient than it sounds: PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion.

steps.text: Finish the story first. The checklist unlocks only after the final mission, but everything you did during the story already counts toward it.

The checklist has 35 requirements. Most need only partial completion — 200 of 277 base vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets — while robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything.

The only tasks that need 100% are robberies (39 gang ops, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans, 8 vaults), all 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting range golds, all 42 drone trials and all 15 of Bret's target decks.
Budget about 100 hours after the story for the checklist, on top of 60–80 hours for the story itself. PowerPyx puts the whole platinum at roughly 200 hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver for 250 stunts. There are 397 stunts in Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Any 250 count for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants 300.

steps.text: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. The four kinds are stunt jumps (130), under-bridge flights (202), knife flights (40) and base jumps (25).
Stunt jumps are the easiest to farm: drive fast at a marked ramp and land cleanly. Under-bridge flights need a plane or helicopter and a steady line under the bridge.
Track progress under Progress > Stats. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.
Knife flights and base jumps are the rarest kinds — 40 and 25 in the whole state — so the bulk of your 250 will be jumps and bridge flights.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Bronze for trying each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything.

steps.text: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
Most of these unlock naturally while playing: the shooting range and races open from Chapter 2, and fishing and hunting arrive with their story introductions.
The arcade game counts for Stick Fiddler too, and a race counts toward Earn Cash, Not Kudos — so this trophy overlaps with two others.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver for gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the hardest skill requirement on the list. Two ranges host them: Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero and Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn. Buy the $5 waiver pass from the clerk inside before the challenges appear on the map.

steps.text: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero) and Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn).
Buy the $5 waiver pass from the clerk inside each range before the challenges appear on the map.
Guides disagree on the challenge count — PowerPyx lists 12 challenges in one place and 14 in another, Push Square counts 42 — but all agree on 42 gold medals. See dispute d3.
Shooting ranges also raise your Focus stat, which makes Gunslinger easier, so do these before going for 5 kills in one Combat Focus.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Bronze for winning a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has 3 races (42 time trials in all); beating the par time in the first two unlocks the third. The trophy needs one win per location; 100% needs all 42 trials.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Some locations charge an entry fee.
Find locations on the map under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.
Each location holds 3 races: beat the par time in the first two to unlock the third. The trophy needs one win per location; the 100% checklist needs all 42 trials done.
Do the full set at each location while you are there — returning later to mop up the third race at 14 separate spots wastes trips.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Bronze for winning 20 different races. There are 40 unique races in 6 groups across Leonida; the 100% checklist wants 30 of them won, plus 10 of the 13 race challenge gold medals.

steps.text: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique races in 6 groups; blue race icons appear on the map once you are within about 100 metres.
Filter for them under Map > Activities > Racing so you can plan a route instead of stumbling on them.
The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 races won and 10 of 13 race challenge gold medals, so keep racing past 20 if you are chasing A Long Road.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Bronze for beating Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also feeds Master of None.

steps.text: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge, then out-fish him. The challenge is a scored fishing contest, not free fishing.
Fishing spots are found along the coast and the Grassrivers wetlands; the challenge itself is issued by Cal when you meet him.
If you lose, you can retry the challenge — fishing challenges are repeatable, unlike the story missions.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Bronze for completing one arcade game. Any arcade cabinet counts, and the video game activity also ticks one of the 9 types for Master of None.

steps.text: Play any arcade game to completion at an arcade cabinet in Vice City.
Arcade games are found in bars and arcades around Vice City; the cabinet itself is the activity, not a story mission.
One finished game is enough — you do not need a high score or to beat every cabinet.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Andy's stranger mission strand. Stranger strands are the black-icon missions with pink letters; five strangers have final missions that each carry a trophy.

steps.text: Play Andy's stranger missions through to his final mission and complete it.
Stranger missions appear as black icons with pink letters, plus purple map icons. They are optional but most count toward the 100 optional tasks on the checklist.
Each of the five stranger finals — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — has its own trophy, and all five feed Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Kenton's final mission. Kenton's strand is also the treasure-diving questline behind the 33 underwater discoveries and the Kenton sets on the 100% checklist.

steps.text: Play Kenton's stranger missions through to his final mission and complete it.
Kenton's strand ties into diving: the 100% checklist wants 5 of 7 Kenton sets and all 33 underwater discoveries, which are sunken shipwrecks on his treasure questline.
Track Kenton's progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees or Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Billy's final stranger mission. Like the other stranger finals, it counts toward Strangers & Freaks and toward the 100 optional tasks.

steps.text: Play Billy's stranger missions through to his final mission and complete it.
Stranger missions are optional tasks: there are far more than the 100 the checklist wants, so you will clear 100 naturally while doing the strands.
TechWiser reports that the stranger chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress, so do not leave the strands until after the ending if you can help it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver for completing 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. The five named stranger finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of them; three more strands complete the eight.

steps.text: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state. Each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger, ending in a final mission.
The five stranger finals each have their own trophy: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone. Those five count toward the eight.
Find strands by their black icons with pink letters and purple map markers, and take them as they appear during the story — some chains have windows tied to story progress.
Stranger missions also feed the 100 optional tasks on the checklist, so this silver overlaps heavily with A Long Road.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Randy's final stranger mission. Randy runs the garage in Balsero, near the Griffin Shooting Range — convenient to pair with The Shootist.

steps.text: Play Randy's stranger missions through to his final mission and complete it.
Randy's garage is in Balsero, the same neighbourhood as the Griffin Shooting Range, so pair his strand with shooting range visits.
This is one of the five stranger finals that feed Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Tyrone's final stranger mission. The last of the five named stranger finals.

steps.text: Play Tyrone's stranger missions through to his final mission and complete it.
With all five finals done — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — you are five eighths of the way to Strangers & Freaks.
Stranger strands are best done during the story: guides report some chains have windows tied to story progress.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Bronze for meditating at every spot across Leonida — 18 completions at 10 locations. Eight outdoor spots count twice (once per protagonist), plus the Chapter 1 balcony lesson at Jason's house and the final Mount Kalaga summit. This is the only trophy any guide flags as possibly missable: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1.

steps.text: Meditate at all 10 spots: Jason's house balcony (Chapter 1 only), Smooth Sand, Swamp, Worn Stone, Red Rocks, Water Wheel, Jutting Cliff and three more outdoor spots, ending at the Mount Kalaga summit.
Each outdoor spot counts twice — once with Jason and once with Lucia — for 18 completions in total. Bring your partner (call them so you go together) and meditate with both.

Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1. PowerPyx and KeenGamer flag it as the only currently identified possibly missable interaction; GTADB notes whether the trophy actually needs it is unresolved. See dispute d2.

The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, but the trophy needs all 18. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, or the map's Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida filter.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bronze for hunting a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting quests are one of the five things the 100% checklist wants in full — all 15 of his target decks — and hunting is one of the 9 activity types.

steps.text: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret gives hunting quests; the target animal is unique, so study it through the binoculars first to confirm it.
Studying animals through the binoculars counts toward the 100 animals the checklist wants — you do not need to hunt and skin them, unlike Red Dead Redemption 2.
The checklist wants all 15 of Bret's target decks, so keep taking his hunts after this trophy pops.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver for completing 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 480 cards in 18 sets — sports teams from Vice City, Liberty City and Los Santos, plus wrestling, comic-book heroes and club dancers. The 100% checklist wants 15 full sets.

steps.text: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found in phone boxes, on walls and on surfaces around Leonida.
The 18 sets hold 480 cards in all — for example 24 Vice City Flamingos, 24 Vice City Narcos, 24 Vice City Manatees and 30 Vice City Club De Fútbol.
Finding all 24 Vice City Flamingos cards also unlocks the Bubblegum screen filter. Track sets under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so this silver is a milestone on the way to A Long Road, not a side quest.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver for scanning 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app. WAiNK spots fall into 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus billboards and tags. Scan on foot — the nearby-scan notice does not fire from the driver's seat.

steps.text: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app. Hold Up on the D-pad to open it, point at the starburst marker and hold R1 until the capture finishes.
The mix is 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus Peewees billboards and No Flusher tags. Scan on foot: the notice, vibration and sound cue do not fire while you drive.
Guides disagree on the total — 108 scans by one count, 112 by another (the tag count differs, 15 vs 23). The trophy needs 100 either way. See dispute d1.
Track scans under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations. Named landmarks include the Gellhorn Fun Fair ferris wheel, the Dock Ring and the Belpoint Lighthouse.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Bronze for completing 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in 8 categories of 10; the trophy needs any 50, while the 100% checklist needs 70 — so you can skip the 10 nastiest ones.

steps.text: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. They come in 8 categories with 10 challenges each.
Challenges cover combat, driving, flying, stunts and more, and most complete naturally while you play toward 100%.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 — you may skip the hardest 10.
Check which challenges are done under Progress > Stats, and pick the easy categories first if you are short near the end.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Bronze for losing a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escaping. It often pops by itself: robbing a bank vault instantly gives you a 4-star wanted level.

steps.text: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape the heat.
The easiest route is a bank vault robbery: it instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, which also feeds Maximum Withdrawal.
Break line of sight, switch vehicles and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. Your partner must be with you when the level drops.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Pick three shops close together, keep the partner close, and do not let the wanted level drop between robberies.

steps.text: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them.
Choose three shops on the same street so the gaps are short, and keep your partner beside you for each robbery.
Do not lose the cops mid-chain: the count resets if the wanted level clears. If it does, start the three again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Bronze for discovering 100 vehicles. Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app as you meet them — the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so start scanning from the beginning.

steps.text: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan every new vehicle you see with the WAiNK app, including boats and aircraft.
Vehicle scans land under Progress > Vehicles, separate from the WAiNK location scans. The checklist wants any 200 of the 277 base model vehicles.
Scan from the start of the game: vehicles you pass early are the ones you will otherwise have to hunt down in cleanup.
Guides disagree on the WAiNK location total (108 vs 112) but agree on vehicles: 200 of 277 base models for 100%. See dispute d1.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Bronze for taking down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Buff your Focus first — food, drinks or a shower at home, plus Adrenaline — and use an assault rifle in a busy fight.

steps.text: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Pick a fight with plenty of enemies and trigger Focus once they are grouped.
Buff Focus before the fight with food, drinks or a shower at home, and bring Adrenaline. An assault rifle works best for chaining kills.
Shooting ranges raise your Focus stat, so gold the 42 range medals first — The Shootist makes Gunslinger noticeably easier. See dispute d3.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze for making an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. Steal a plane and take off without following the airport's routine — the joke is in the name.

steps.text: Go to VCIA (the airport), get into a plane and take off without a scheduled departure.
The airport is the scene of the story mission VCIA Takedown, so you will know the layout by the time you come back for this one.
Expect a wanted level on the runway: leave fast and lose the heat once you are airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze with a joke description — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' It involves a Rhino tank. Guides agree it is a secret tied to the tank; the exact trigger is thinly documented, so treat the steps below as the reported route, not a guarantee.

steps.text: Find a Rhino tank and use it. GamesFuze describes this trophy as a secret involving a Rhino tank.
Rhino tanks appear at military and restricted sites; expect heavy resistance when you take one.
If the tank route does not pop it, check back after launch guides confirm the trigger — this is one of the least documented trophies on the list.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and get out before the alarm.

steps.text: Rob a jewelry store without being detected: stay out of sight, avoid cameras and staff, and leave before any alarm.
Go at night and keep your distance from the counter staff until you are ready to move.
If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, lose the heat and try again. The $100,000 jewelry fencing on the 100% checklist is separate progress.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver for robbing 5 bank vaults and escaping. Vaults are the big robberies: each one instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, which is also how Hot Together pops. The 100% checklist wants 8 vaults hit.

steps.text: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are found in banks around Leonida; the robbery itself is the hard part, the escape is the trophy.
Each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so bring your partner and Hot Together may pop on the same run.
Plan the escape before you go in: a fast car parked close, a route out of the search area, and no stopping to fight.
The 100% checklist wants 8 of 8 vaults hit, so keep robbing past 5 if you are chasing A Long Road.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing an armored truck and escaping — a classic GTA move. Armored trucks run set routes around the city; hit one, grab the cash and lose the heat.

steps.text: Find an armored truck on its route, rob it and escape.
Trucks are armored and guarded, so hit the guards fast and get moving before the wanted level climbs.
The 100% checklist counts robberies of every kind, so this also feeds the 39 gang operations and 22 bank jobs indirectly.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Bronze for exploring all of Leonida — the whole state, not just Vice City. Rockstar's six regions are Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park. WAiNK scanning is the practical way to track it.

steps.text: Explore all of Leonida: visit every region and district until the map is filled in.
Rockstar's six official regions are Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.
Use the WAiNK app as you travel: scanning its 100 locations takes you through most of the state, and the scans are tracked under Progress > Collections.
Do not rush it in one drive — exploration overlaps with stunts, races, collectibles and stranger missions, so it finishes itself during the 100% run.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing an illegal operation belonging to each gang. The 100% checklist wants all 39 gang operations cleared, so this trophy is one stop on a much longer robbery list.

steps.text: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida.
Gang operations are marked on the map once discovered; each gang's turf has its own operations.
The 100% checklist wants 39 of 39 gang operations cleared, so this trophy pops early in that grind.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze, unconfirmed: the description says to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No guide has confirmed the trigger yet — only the description is known. Flagged unconfirmed until two guides agree on how it unlocks.

steps.text: Unconfirmed: the official description is 'Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.' No guide has confirmed what action unlocks it.
Do not chase rumoured triggers for this trophy. It stays unconfirmed here until two independent guides agree on the unlock.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze, unconfirmed: the description says to smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No guide has confirmed the trigger yet. Flagged unconfirmed until two guides agree.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze for a follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowling is one of the activities; the exact follow-through is thinly documented, but the location is named in the description itself.

steps.text: Go to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and bowl. The description names the alley, so the location is certain even if the exact follow-through is thinly documented.
Bowling counts as one of the activities for Master of None, and a good game may tie into Ten Pin, the hidden melee drive-by trophy.
If the trophy does not pop from a normal game, try a full game with your partner — partner activities are a recurring pattern in this list.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze for choices made, for better or worse. The story has decision points; this trophy is tied to making one. Which choice, and whether it can be missed, is not yet documented well enough to give a firm step.

steps.text: Make a story choice when the game offers one. The description — 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — points at a decision point in the story.
Keep a manual save before each major decision so you can revisit it: there is no mission replay, and the game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.
If it has not popped by the ending, the choice is likely one of the late-story decisions — check launch guides for the confirmed choice once they agree.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Bronze for laundering $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; the 100% checklist wants the same $250,000 fenced, so this trophy and the checklist target are identical.

steps.text: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — bank jobs, vaults and stick-ups.
Fence the bills through contacts as you earn them; the total is cumulative across the whole game.
The 100% checklist wants exactly the same $250,000 fenced, so this trophy pops on the way to A Long Road.
Robberies pay in Marked Bills, so the fastest route is the robbery grind itself: 39 gang ops, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans and 8 vaults.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Bronze for spending $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades all count — and you will spend far more than this on the way to 100% anyway.

steps.text: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops: weapons, clothes, cars, upgrades and properties all count.
Do not force it early: the money for the 100% grind (weapons, vehicles, garage properties) passes $100,000 on its own.
If it has not popped by the endgame, buy a high-end vehicle or weapon to push the total over the line.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Bronze for purchasing all garage properties. KeenGamer counts eight purchasable garages; buy them all and the trophy pops. Garages also store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.

steps.text: Purchase all garage properties. KeenGamer counts eight purchasable garages across Leonida.
Garages are bought with in-game money, so this trophy comes late — after the robbery income starts flowing.
Garages store the vehicles you register for On the Spot, so buy garages before you start registering your collection.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Bronze for registering 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any 10 vehicles count — the ones you discover with WAiNK are the natural candidates, since Whip It Good wants 100 discovered.

steps.text: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone and register vehicles you own or have found.
The vehicles you discover with WAiNK for Whip It Good are the natural candidates — discover, then register.
You need garage space to keep them, so Little Boxes (all 8 garages) pairs naturally with this one.
